title: Find schools that are exclusively virtual (Virtual = 'F') and serve a K-12
question: Find schools that are exclusively virtual (Virtual = 'F') and serve a K-12 grade span. Among these, return only those whose difference between K-12 enrollment and Ages 5-17 enrollment exceeds the average such difference across all locally funded schools. For each qualifying school, list its name, city, website, and total enrollment (K-12).

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS name,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_060 AS website,
    f.XCL_019 AS k12_enrollment,
    f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024 AS enrollment_diff,
    s.XCL_065 AS funding_type
  FROM frpm AS f
  INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
  WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
    AND s.XCL_075 = 'K-12'
)
SELECT
  b.name,
  b.city,
  b.website,
  b.k12_enrollment
FROM base AS b
WHERE b.enrollment_diff > (
  SELECT AVG(b2.enrollment_diff)
  FROM base AS b2
  WHERE b2.funding_type = 'Locally funded'
)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS name,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_060 AS website,
    f.XCL_019 AS k12_enrollment,
    f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_024 AS enrollment_diff,
    s.XCL_065 AS funding_type
  FROM frpm AS f
  INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
  WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
    AND s.XCL_075 = 'K-12'
)
SELECT
  b.name,
  b.city,
  b.website,
  b.k12_enrollment
FROM base AS b
WHERE b.enrollment_diff > (
  SELECT AVG(b2.enrollment_diff)
  FROM base AS b2
  WHERE b2.funding_type = 'Locally funded'
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.XCL_042 AS name,
    s.XCL_043 AS city,
    s.XCL_044 AS website,
    f.XCL_019 AS k12_enrollment,
    f.XCL_019 - f.XCL_020 AS enrollment_diff,
    f.XCL_015 AS funding_type
  FROM frpm f
  INNER JOIN schools s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
  WHERE f.XCL_005 = 'F'
    AND f.XCL_017 = 'K'
    AND f.XCL_018 = '12'
)
SELECT
  b.name,
  b.city,
  b.website,
  b.k12_enrollment
FROM base b
WHERE b.enrollment_diff > (
  SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) FROM base WHERE funding_type = 'Locally funded'
)
